label: KEATING // LOCAL RECALL
format: short story — one learner across three weeks, illustrated

tts.instructions: Voice: a warm, grounded teacher who genuinely likes their students. Tone: calm, curious and a little wry; never salesy. Pacing: unhurried and conversational, with a small breath at each em dash and a real pause after questions. Pronounce 'Keating' as KEE-ting. This film is a short story: read the first three lines softly, like the opening of a picture book.

scenes.text: Tuesday night. Standing waves, one more time.
An exam question asks about resonance — and it's all a blur.
Keating 4.0 remembers. Before it replies, local recall finds the exact passage from her earlier work — and keeps a reference to where it came from.
It runs on her own machine: a thirty-six megabyte model, switched on in Learning Settings. On a phone, search by meaning finds sessions by idea, not keyword.
Your past work, working for you.
